name: precedentes
description: Brazilian case law (STF, STJ and 70+ courts) with the official court link in every decision.

interface.longDescription: Precedentes: jurisprudência brasileira do STF, do STJ e de mais 70 tribunais e órgãos, com o link oficial do tribunal em cada decisão. Precedentes connects ChatGPT to a database of Brazilian court decisions (STF, STJ and more than 70 other courts and agencies), laws, binding precedents and official court gazettes. Every decision returned comes with the official link to the court's website, so lawyers can check the source before citing it. Lawyers can search case law in plain Portuguese, verify whether the precedents cited in a text exist, see success-rate statistics with the universe, period and criteria declared, read the full text of decisions, follow a case by its CNJ number, compute procedural deadlines and legal calculations, and draft briefs for their own review and signature. The app only reads public data from courts and official sources; drafts are always for the lawyer's review and are never filed automatically.
interface.defaultPrompt: Quais precedentes do STJ tratam de dano moral por negativação indevida?

positive.description: Case-law search: a lawyer asks for Superior Court of Justice (STJ) precedents on moral damages for wrongful credit blacklisting. Prompt in Portuguese ('Which STJ precedents deal with moral damages for wrongful inclusion in credit-protection lists?').
positive.prompt: Quais precedentes do STJ tratam de dano moral por negativação indevida?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of STJ decisions on moral damages for wrongful credit blacklisting, each with case number, court division, date, summary (ementa) excerpt, authority level and the official link to stj.jus.br; the STJ binding summary (Súmula 385) is highlighted when relevant.

positive.description: Citation check: the lawyer pastes a paragraph with citations and asks whether the cited precedents exist. Prompt: 'Check whether these citations exist: REsp 1.061.134/RS and Súmula 385 do STJ.'
positive.prompt: Confira se estas citações existem: REsp 1.061.134/RS e Súmula 385 do STJ.
positive.expected_behavior: For each citation, whether it was found in the index, with the identified decision or summary, its official link, and a flag for any citation that could not be found.

positive.description: Binding summaries and repetitive themes: the lawyer asks what the STJ binding summary 7 says. Prompt: 'What does STJ Súmula 7 say and how is it applied?'
positive.prompt: O que diz a Súmula 7 do STJ e como ela é aplicada?
positive.expected_behavior: The full text of STJ Súmula 7 (re-examination of evidence is not allowed in a special appeal), its status, the official link, and examples of decisions applying it with their links.

positive.description: Case-law statistics (jurimetrics): the lawyer asks the success rate of special appeals at the STJ Third Division on a topic. Prompt: 'What is the success rate of special appeals about moral damages in the STJ Third Panel in the last 5 years?'
positive.prompt: Qual a taxa de êxito de recursos especiais sobre dano moral na Terceira Turma do STJ nos últimos 5 anos?
positive.expected_behavior: Counts of decisions in favor and against with the success rate, plus the universe (court, panel, class, topic), the period and the counting criteria, with links to sample decisions.

positive.description: Procedural deadlines for a public case: the lawyer asks the deadlines of a public TJDFT case by its CNJ number. Prompt: 'What are the deadlines in case 0703790-72.2025.8.07.0011?'
positive.prompt: Quais são os prazos do processo 0703790-72.2025.8.07.0011?
positive.expected_behavior: The publications found in the official gazette (DJEN) for the case, each with its date, the deadline computed in business days (skipping weekends, holidays and court recess) and the link to the official publication.

negative.description: General cooking question unrelated to law: the app should not be triggered.
negative.prompt: Me passa uma receita de bolo de cenoura com cobertura de chocolate.

negative.description: U.S. law question (outside Brazilian law): the app covers only Brazilian courts and should not be triggered.
negative.prompt: What did the US Supreme Court decide in Roe v. Wade?

negative.description: Request to file a lawsuit automatically on the user's behalf: the app never files anything; it should not be triggered to file, and at most ChatGPT explains that briefs are drafts for the lawyer's review.
negative.prompt: Protocole agora uma ação no TJSP em meu nome contra a operadora de celular.
